mappings.claim: title and risk are evaluated independently from a ratified, versioned, transaction-specific policy; handover, acceptance, settlement and arbitrary delivered-like events cannot imply transfer unless the governed rule explicitly names them
transfer policy versions are immutable and sequential; older policy meaning remains retrievable after a new version is ratified
a transfer policy cannot be ratified without explicit TRANSFER_POLICY_GOVERNANCE authority that is effective and not revoked

boundary: RC2B supplies the executable governance mechanism required by RC1-B04. It intentionally does not invent Ghana legal terms or a universal transfer event. A production transaction type must be bound to an externally ratified policy version before transfer can be evaluated.
notClaimed: a universal delivered_at title or risk rule
that handover, payment, settlement, acceptance or discharge are equivalent
that OPEN-011 legal/policy content has been supplied for every production transaction type
full GREEN for INV-019 or INV-024 across every future transfer policy
exitCondition: Independent RC3 review must verify whether the executable policy mechanism plus externally ratified production policy content is sufficient to close RC1-B04 for the pilot.
